title: Finite local-ring map at a singleton fibre of a finite morphism
statement: Let $p:T\to U$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], let $t\in T$ and $u=p(t)$, and suppose $p^{-1}(\{u\})=\{t\}$. The canonical local-ring homomorphism $p_t^\sharp:\mathcal O_{U,u}\to\mathcal O_{T,t}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is finite, meaning that $\mathcal O_{T,t}$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_{U,u}$-module. If $p$ is of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then this ring homomorphism is of finite presentation: for some $a,b\geq0$ there are polynomials $f_1,\ldots,f_b\in\mathcal O_{U,u}[x_1,\ldots,x_a]$ and an $\mathcal O_{U,u}$-algebra isomorphism $\mathcal O_{T,t}\cong\mathcal O_{U,u}[x_1,\ldots,x_a]/(f_1,\ldots,f_b)$.
